title: Matrix Diagonal Sum
description:
You are given a square matrix mat of size n × n.

Find the sum of:

All elements on the main diagonal (top-left to bottom-right)
All elements on the secondary diagonal (top-right to bottom-left)

Important:

If an element lies on both diagonals (only happens when n is odd), count it only once.
input_format:
The first line contains two integers m and n.
The next m lines each contain n space-separated integers.
constraints:
1 ≤ n ≤ 100
mat is a square matrix
1 ≤ mat[i][j] ≤ 100
